items.question: Trong câu "Many interview problems are variations on a handful of reusable shapes, and recognising the shape usually turns an O(n²) brute force into O(n) or O(log n).", từ "variation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many interview problems are variations on a handful of reusable shapes, and recognising the shape usually turns an O(n²) brute force into O(n) or O(log n).", what does "variation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: variation /ˌveəriˈeɪʃn/ (danh từ): biến thể. "A variation on something" = một biến thể của cái gì; nhiều bài phỏng vấn chỉ là biến thể của vài dạng quen thuộc.
items.explanationEn: variation /ˌveəriˈeɪʃn/ (noun): a slightly different version. "A variation on something" is a changed version of it; many interview problems are variations on a few familiar shapes.

items.question: Trong câu "Many interview problems are variations on a handful of reusable shapes, and recognising the shape usually turns an O(n²) brute force into O(n) or O(log n).", từ "a handful of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many interview problems are variations on a handful of reusable shapes, and recognising the shape usually turns an O(n²) brute force into O(n) or O(log n).", what does "a handful of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: a handful of /ə ˈhændfʊl əv/ (cụm từ): một số ít. "A handful of" nghĩa đen là một nắm tay, nhưng thường dùng để chỉ một số lượng nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: a handful of /ə ˈhændfʊl əv/ (phrase): a small number of. Literally the amount one hand can hold, "a handful of" usually just means a small number of things.

items.question: Trong câu "Many interview problems are variations on a handful of reusable shapes, and recognising the shape usually turns an O(n²) brute force into O(n) or O(log n).", từ "reusable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many interview problems are variations on a handful of reusable shapes, and recognising the shape usually turns an O(n²) brute force into O(n) or O(log n).", what does "reusable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reusable /ˌriːˈjuːzəbl/ (tính từ): dùng lại được. Tiền tố "re-" = lại, hậu tố "-able" = có thể; "reusable code" là mã có thể tái sử dụng.
items.explanationEn: reusable /ˌriːˈjuːzəbl/ (adjective): able to be used again. The prefix "re-" means again and "-able" means can be; "reusable code" can be used in many places.

items.question: Trong câu "Many interview problems are variations on a handful of reusable shapes, and recognising the shape usually turns an O(n²) brute force into O(n) or O(log n).", từ "recognise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many interview problems are variations on a handful of reusable shapes, and recognising the shape usually turns an O(n²) brute force into O(n) or O(log n).", what does "recognise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in a new order
items.explanation: recognise /ˈrekəɡnaɪz/ (động từ): nhận ra. Anh-Anh viết "recognise", Anh-Mỹ viết "recognize"; "recognise a pattern" = nhận ra một mẫu.
items.explanationEn: recognise /ˈrekəɡnaɪz/ (verb): to identify something known. British spelling is "recognise", American is "recognize"; "recognise a pattern" means to spot it.

items.question: Trong câu "The rule for everything here: first write down the naive complexity, then ask which pattern removes the repeated work.", từ "naive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rule for everything here: first write down the naive complexity, then ask which pattern removes the repeated work.", what does "naive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: naive /naɪˈiːv/ (tính từ): đơn giản, chưa tối ưu. Trong thuật toán, "naive solution" là lời giải đầu tiên, trực tiếp, chưa tối ưu; nghĩa đời thường là ngây thơ.
items.explanationEn: naive /naɪˈiːv/ (adjective): simple and not optimised. In algorithms a "naive solution" is the first, direct approach without optimisation; in everyday use it means too trusting.

items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic programming, greedy algorithms and backtracking are patterns too; they get their own topics later.", từ "greedy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic programming, greedy algorithms and backtracking are patterns too; they get their own topics later.", what does "greedy" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: picking the best step each time
items.explanation: greedy /ˈɡriːdi/ (tính từ): tham lam (từng bước). "Greedy algorithm" = thuật toán tham lam, luôn chọn phương án tốt nhất tại thời điểm hiện tại.
items.explanationEn: greedy /ˈɡriːdi/ (adjective): picking the best step each time. A "greedy algorithm" always takes the locally best choice, hoping it leads to a good overall result.

items.question: Trong câu "A frequency counter collects values (or how often each value appears) into an object, Map or Set, so a later question like "does this value exist, and how many times?" is an O(1) lookup instead of a scan.", từ "collect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A frequency counter collects values (or how often each value appears) into an object, Map or Set, so a later question like "does this value exist, and how many times?" is an O(1) lookup instead of a scan.", what does "collect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collect /kəˈlekt/ (động từ): gom, thu thập. "Collect values into a Map" = gom các giá trị vào một Map; danh từ là "collection".
items.explanationEn: collect /kəˈlekt/ (verb): to gather together. "Collect values into a Map" means gathering them in one place; the noun is "collection".

items.question: Trong câu "A frequency counter collects values (or how often each value appears) into an object, Map or Set, so a later question like "does this value exist, and how many times?" is an O(1) lookup instead of a scan.", từ "scan" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A frequency counter collects values (or how often each value appears) into an object, Map or Set, so a later question like "does this value exist, and how many times?" is an O(1) lookup instead of a scan.", what does "scan" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an image made by a scanner
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (danh từ): lượt duyệt tuần tự. "A scan" ở đây là việc duyệt qua từng phần tử (O(n)); còn nghĩa "bản quét" dùng cho ảnh hoặc y tế.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (noun): a pass through every item. Here "a scan" means looking through every element (O(n)); it can also mean an image from a scanner.

items.question: Trong câu "Problem: same(arr1, arr2) returns true if every value in arr1 has its square in arr2, with the same frequency.", từ "frequency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Problem: same(arr1, arr2) returns true if every value in arr1 has its square in arr2, with the same frequency.", what does "frequency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the rate of a radio wave
items.explanation: frequency /ˈfriːkwənsi/ (danh từ): số lần xuất hiện. "Frequency counter" đếm mỗi giá trị xuất hiện bao nhiêu lần; trong vật lý "frequency" là tần số.
items.explanationEn: frequency /ˈfriːkwənsi/ (noun): how often something occurs. A "frequency counter" tracks how many times each value appears; in physics "frequency" is a wave's rate.

items.question: Trong câu "Frequency counter: one pass to count the squares, one pass to consume them.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Frequency counter: one pass to count the squares, one pass to consume them.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): dùng dần, trừ bớt. "Consume a count" = dùng hết/trừ dần một lượt đếm; "consume memory" = tiêu tốn bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to use up gradually. "Consume a count" means using it up; "consume memory" means using memory.

items.question: Trong câu "Frequency counter: one pass to count the squares, one pass to consume them.", từ "pass" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Frequency counter: one pass to count the squares, one pass to consume them.", what does "pass" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pass /pɑːs/ (danh từ): một lượt duyệt. "One pass" = một lượt duyệt qua dữ liệu; "two-pass algorithm" = thuật toán duyệt hai lượt.
items.explanationEn: pass /pɑːs/ (noun): one run through the data. "One pass" is a single run over the data; a "two-pass algorithm" goes over it twice.

items.question: Trong câu "Because the lengths match and every value in arr2 consumed exactly one count, no leftovers are possible.", từ "leftover" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because the lengths match and every value in arr2 consumed exactly one count, no leftovers are possible.", what does "leftover" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: leftover /ˈleftəʊvə(r)/ (danh từ): phần còn dư. Thường dùng số nhiều "leftovers" = phần thừa lại; cũng hay chỉ đồ ăn thừa.
items.explanationEn: leftover /ˈleftəʊvə(r)/ (noun): something remaining unused. Usually plural, "leftovers" are what remains unused; it often means food left after a meal.

items.question: Trong câu "Two strings are anagrams if one is a rearrangement of the other ("cinema" / "iceman").", từ "rearrangement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two strings are anagrams if one is a rearrangement of the other ("cinema" / "iceman").", what does "rearrangement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rearrangement /ˌriːəˈreɪndʒmənt/ (danh từ): sự sắp xếp lại. Động từ "rearrange" = sắp xếp lại; anagram là cách sắp xếp lại các chữ cái của một từ.
items.explanationEn: rearrangement /ˌriːəˈreɪndʒmənt/ (noun): a change in the order. The verb is "rearrange"; an anagram is a rearrangement of a word's letters.

items.question: Trong câu "O(n) time; space O(k) for k distinct characters, which is O(1) for a fixed alphabet like a–z.", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "O(n) time; space O(k) for k distinct characters, which is O(1) for a fixed alphabet like a–z.", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): khác nhau, không trùng. "Distinct values" = các giá trị phân biệt (không trùng); "a distinct smell" lại nghĩa là rõ rệt.
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): different from each other. "Distinct values" are values with no duplicates; "a distinct smell" means one that is clearly noticeable.

items.question: Trong câu "A plain {} turns keys into strings (1 and "1" collide) and inherits keys like constructor.", từ "collide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A plain {} turns keys into strings (1 and "1" collide) and inherits keys like constructor.", what does "collide" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to clash by being the same
items.explanation: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (động từ): trùng nhau (xung đột). Hai khóa "collide" khi bị coi là cùng một khóa; danh từ "hash collision" = xung đột băm.
items.explanationEn: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (verb): to clash by being the same. Two keys "collide" when they end up as the same key; the noun is used in "hash collision".

items.question: Trong câu "A plain {} turns keys into strings (1 and "1" collide) and inherits keys like constructor.", từ "inherit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A plain {} turns keys into strings (1 and "1" collide) and inherits keys like constructor.", what does "inherit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inherit /ɪnˈherɪt/ (động từ): kế thừa. Object thường "inherits" thuộc tính từ prototype; ngoài đời "inherit" là thừa kế tài sản.
items.explanationEn: inherit /ɪnˈherɪt/ (verb): to receive from a parent. A plain object "inherits" properties from its prototype; in daily life you inherit money or land.

items.question: Trong câu "Fine for letters; for arbitrary words use a Map.", từ "arbitrary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fine for letters; for arbitrary words use a Map.", what does "arbitrary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: arbitrary /ˈɑːbɪtrəri/ (tính từ): bất kỳ, tùy ý. "Arbitrary keys" = khóa bất kỳ; "an arbitrary decision" lại mang nghĩa quyết định tùy tiện.
items.explanationEn: arbitrary /ˈɑːbɪtrəri/ (adjective): any, without restriction. "Arbitrary keys" means any possible keys; "an arbitrary decision" means one made without good reason.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep a running sub-range and update it incrementally", từ "incrementally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep a running sub-range and update it incrementally", what does "incrementally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: incrementally /ˌɪŋkrəˈmentəli/ (trạng từ): từng bước nhỏ. "Update incrementally" = cập nhật dần từng chút thay vì tính lại từ đầu; danh từ "increment".
items.explanationEn: incrementally /ˌɪŋkrəˈmentəli/ (adverb): in small steps over time. "Update incrementally" means changing a little each step instead of recomputing; the noun is "increment".

items.question: Trong câu "Multiple pointers keeps two or more indices and moves them toward the start, end or middle based on a condition.", từ "index" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multiple pointers keeps two or more indices and moves them toward the start, end or middle based on a condition.", what does "index" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a position number in a list
a list at the back of a book
the value stored in a slot
items.explanation: index /ˈɪndeks/ (danh từ): chỉ số (vị trí). Số nhiều là "indices" hoặc "indexes"; "arr[i]" dùng chỉ số i để truy cập phần tử.
items.explanationEn: index /ˈɪndeks/ (noun): a position number in a list. The plural is "indices" or "indexes"; in arr[i], i is the index of the element.

items.question: Trong câu "It usually needs sorted input and uses O(1) extra space.", từ "extra" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It usually needs sorted input and uses O(1) extra space.", what does "extra" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: extra /ˈekstrə/ (tính từ): thêm, bổ sung. "Extra space" = bộ nhớ phụ cần thêm ngoài dữ liệu đầu vào.
items.explanationEn: extra /ˈekstrə/ (adjective): added beyond what is usual. "Extra space" is the memory an algorithm needs beyond the input itself.

items.question: Trong câu "Problem: sumZero(sortedArr) returns the first pair that sums to 0, or undefined.", từ "sum to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Problem: sumZero(sortedArr) returns the first pair that sums to 0, or undefined.", what does "sum to" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to add up to a total
items.explanation: sum to /sʌm tə/ (cụm từ): có tổng bằng. "A pair that sums to 0" = cặp số có tổng bằng 0; "sum up" lại nghĩa là tóm tắt.
items.explanationEn: sum to /sʌm tə/ (phrase): to add up to a total. "A pair that sums to 0" adds up to zero; "sum up" instead means to summarise.

items.question: Trong câu "The naive answer checks every pair with two nested loops: O(n²) time, O(1) space.", từ "nested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The naive answer checks every pair with two nested loops: O(n²) time, O(1) space.", what does "nested" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: nested /ˈnestɪd/ (tính từ): lồng nhau. "Nested loops" = vòng lặp lồng nhau, thường dẫn đến O(n²).
items.explanationEn: nested /ˈnestɪd/ (adjective): placed one inside another. "Nested loops" are loops inside loops and often mean O(n²) time.

items.question: Trong câu "The mirror argument drops arr[left] when the sum is negative.", từ "mirror" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The mirror argument drops arr[left] when the sum is negative.", what does "mirror" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mirror /ˈmɪrə(r)/ (tính từ): đối xứng, ngược lại. "The mirror argument" = lập luận đối xứng, áp dụng y hệt cho phía còn lại.
items.explanationEn: mirror /ˈmɪrə(r)/ (adjective): symmetric, reversed. "The mirror argument" is the same reasoning applied to the opposite side.

items.question: Trong câu "The mirror argument drops arr[left] when the sum is negative.", từ "argument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The mirror argument drops arr[left] when the sum is negative.", what does "argument" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a reason given to prove something
a value passed to a function
items.explanation: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (danh từ): lập luận. "Argument" có nhiều nghĩa: lập luận, cuộc cãi nhau, hoặc đối số truyền vào hàm; ở đây là lập luận.
items.explanationEn: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (noun): a reason given to prove something. "Argument" can mean reasoning, a quarrel, or a value passed to a function; here it is reasoning.

items.question: Trong câu "Each step removes one candidate, so there are at most n − 1 steps.", từ "candidate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each step removes one candidate, so there are at most n − 1 steps.", what does "candidate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: candidate /ˈkændɪdət/ (danh từ): phương án khả dĩ. Trong thuật toán, "candidate" là phần tử còn có thể là đáp án; mỗi bước loại bỏ một ứng viên.
items.explanationEn: candidate /ˈkændɪdət/ (noun): a possible choice being considered. In algorithms a "candidate" is an element that could still be the answer; each step removes one.

items.question: Trong câu "Each step removes one candidate, so there are at most n − 1 steps.", từ "at most" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each step removes one candidate, so there are at most n − 1 steps.", what does "at most" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at most /ət məʊst/ (cụm từ): nhiều nhất là. "At most n − 1 steps" = tối đa n − 1 bước; trái nghĩa là "at least" (ít nhất).
items.explanationEn: at most /ət məʊst/ (phrase): no more than. "At most n − 1 steps" means never more than that; the opposite is "at least".

items.question: Trong câu "Pointers do not always start at opposite ends.", từ "opposite" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pointers do not always start at opposite ends.", what does "opposite" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: opposite /ˈɒpəzɪt/ (tính từ): đối diện, ở hai phía. "Opposite ends" = hai đầu đối diện của mảng; con trỏ đi từ hai đầu vào giữa.
items.explanationEn: opposite /ˈɒpəzɪt/ (adjective): on the other side. "Opposite ends" are the two far ends of an array; pointers move inward from them.

items.question: Trong câu "If mutating the input is not allowed, count how often arr[j] !== arr[j - 1] instead — same O(n) / O(1).", từ "mutate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If mutating the input is not allowed, count how often arr[j] !== arr[j - 1] instead — same O(n) / O(1).", what does "mutate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (động từ): sửa dữ liệu gốc. "Mutate the input" = sửa trực tiếp mảng đầu vào; ngược lại là "immutable" (không đổi được).
items.explanationEn: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (verb): to change the original data. "Mutate the input" means changing the original array; the opposite idea is "immutable".

items.question: Trong câu "One pointer per input — e.g. checking whether 'abc' is a subsequence of 'abracadabra': walk the long string, and advance the pointer in the short one on each match.", từ "subsequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One pointer per input — e.g. checking whether 'abc' is a subsequence of 'abracadabra': walk the long string, and advance the pointer in the short one on each match.", what does "subsequence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: items kept in the same order
items.explanation: subsequence /ˈsʌbsiːkwəns/ (danh từ): dãy con (giữ thứ tự). "Subsequence" giữ thứ tự nhưng không cần liền kề; "substring" thì phải liền kề.
items.explanationEn: subsequence /ˈsʌbsiːkwəns/ (noun): items kept in the same order. A "subsequence" keeps order but may skip items; a "substring" must be contiguous.

items.question: Trong câu "One pointer per input — e.g. checking whether 'abc' is a subsequence of 'abracadabra': walk the long string, and advance the pointer in the short one on each match.", từ "advance" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One pointer per input — e.g. checking whether 'abc' is a subsequence of 'abracadabra': walk the long string, and advance the pointer in the short one on each match.", what does "advance" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: advance /ədˈvɑːns/ (động từ): tiến lên, dịch tới. "Advance the pointer" = dịch con trỏ lên một vị trí; "in advance" nghĩa là trước.
items.explanationEn: advance /ədˈvɑːns/ (verb): to move forward. "Advance the pointer" means moving it forward; "in advance" means beforehand.

items.question: Trong câu "A sliding window is a contiguous range [start, end] over an array or string.", từ "contiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sliding window is a contiguous range [start, end] over an array or string.", what does "contiguous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contiguous /kənˈtɪɡjuəs/ (tính từ): liền kề, liên tục. "Contiguous subarray" = mảng con liên tục; đừng nhầm với "contagious" (lây nhiễm).
items.explanationEn: contiguous /kənˈtɪɡjuəs/ (adjective): next to each other, unbroken. A "contiguous subarray" has no gaps; do not confuse it with "contagious".

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of recomputing the range from scratch, you update it as it moves: add what enters, remove what leaves.", từ "recompute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead of recomputing the range from scratch, you update it as it moves: add what enters, remove what leaves.", what does "recompute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: recompute /ˌriːkəmˈpjuːt/ (động từ): tính lại. "Recompute from scratch" = tính lại toàn bộ; sliding window tránh việc này.
items.explanationEn: recompute /ˌriːkəmˈpjuːt/ (verb): to calculate again. "Recompute from scratch" means redoing all the work; a sliding window avoids it.

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of recomputing the range from scratch, you update it as it moves: add what enters, remove what leaves.", từ "from scratch" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: from scratch /frəm skrætʃ/ (phrase): from the very beginning. "Start from scratch" means beginning again without reusing earlier results.

items.question: Trong câu "Problem: maxSubarraySum(arr, k) — the largest sum of k consecutive elements.", từ "consecutive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: consecutive /kənˈsekjətɪv/ (adjective): following one after another. "k consecutive elements" follow one another with no gap, like "three consecutive days".

items.question: Trong câu "Neighbouring windows share k − 1 elements, so most of that work is repeated.", từ "neighbouring" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: neighbouring /ˈneɪbərɪŋ/ (adjective): next to or near. American spelling is "neighboring"; "neighbouring windows" sit right next to each other.

items.question: Trong câu "Neighbouring windows share k − 1 elements, so most of that work is repeated.", từ "share" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: share /ʃeə(r)/ (verb): to have in common. "Windows share k − 1 elements" means those elements belong to both windows.

items.question: Trong câu "When the window size is not given, grow the right edge and shrink the left edge while the condition holds (or until it is restored).", từ "edge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): the outer boundary. "Right edge" and "left edge" are the window's boundaries; in graphs an "edge" connects nodes.

items.question: Trong câu "When the window size is not given, grow the right edge and shrink the left edge while the condition holds (or until it is restored).", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the window size is not given, grow the right edge and shrink the left edge while the condition holds (or until it is restored).", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move to a new place
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): thu hẹp. Quá khứ: shrank, shrunk; "shrink the window" = thu hẹp cửa sổ, trái nghĩa "grow".
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to become smaller. Past forms are shrank and shrunk; "shrink the window" is the opposite of "grow".

items.question: Trong câu "When the window size is not given, grow the right edge and shrink the left edge while the condition holds (or until it is restored).", từ "restore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the window size is not given, grow the right edge and shrink the left edge while the condition holds (or until it is restored).", what does "restore" (verb) mean?

items.explanationEn: restore /rɪˈstɔː(r)/ (verb): to bring back. "The condition is restored" means it holds again; "restore a backup" brings back saved data.

items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. "It relies on non-negative numbers" means it only works if that assumption is true.

items.question: Trong câu "It relies on non-negative numbers: adding never lowers the sum and removing never raises it.", từ "lower" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: lower /ˈləʊə(r)/ (verb): to make less. "Lower the sum" means reduce it; the opposite is "raise".

items.question: Trong câu "A while inside a for looks like O(n²), but each index enters the window once and leaves at most once (left moves at most n times in total), so it is O(n) time, O(1) space.", từ "in total" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: in total /ɪn ˈtəʊtl/ (cụm từ): tổng cộng. "At most n times in total" = tổng cộng tối đa n lần trong cả thuật toán.
items.explanationEn: in total /ɪn ˈtəʊtl/ (phrase): all added together. "At most n times in total" counts every move across the whole algorithm.

items.question: Trong câu "With negatives, shrinking is no longer safe.", từ "no longer" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: no longer /nəʊ ˈlɒŋɡə(r)/ (phrase): not any more. "No longer safe" means it was safe before but is not now; same as "not ... any more".

items.question: Trong câu "Divide and conquer splits the data into smaller chunks and repeats the process on a subset.", từ "chunk" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: chunk /tʃʌŋk/ (noun): a piece of something. "Split into chunks" means into pieces; a "chunked upload" sends data piece by piece.

items.question: Trong câu "Divide and conquer splits the data into smaller chunks and repeats the process on a subset.", từ "subset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: subset /ˈsʌbset/ (danh từ): tập con. "A subset" = một phần của tập lớn; ngược lại "superset" là tập cha.
items.explanationEn: subset /ˈsʌbset/ (noun): a part of a larger set. "A subset" is part of a bigger set; the opposite is a "superset".

items.question: Trong câu "Its simplest form throws half the input away at every step.", từ "throw away" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (cụm từ): loại bỏ. "Throw half the input away" = loại bỏ một nửa dữ liệu; tân ngữ có thể đứng giữa "throw" và "away".
items.explanationEn: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (phrase): to get rid of. "Throw half the input away" means discarding it; the object can sit between "throw" and "away".

items.question: Trong câu "Linear search is O(n).", từ "linear" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linear search is O(n).", what does "linear" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: linear /ˈlɪniə(r)/ (tính từ): tuyến tính. "Linear search" = tìm kiếm tuần tự, thời gian O(n); "linear time" = thời gian tuyến tính.
items.explanationEn: linear /ˈlɪniə(r)/ (adjective): growing in proportion to n. "Linear search" checks items one by one in O(n); "linear time" grows with input size.

items.question: Trong câu "The condition is min <= max (not <) so a one-element range is still checked.", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): a span between two limits. "A one-element range" is a span where min equals max.

items.question: Trong câu "Binary search has its own topic later (off-by-one variants, first/last occurrence).", từ "variant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: variant /ˈveəriənt/ (noun): a different form of something. "Off-by-one variants" are slightly different versions; do not confuse with "variable".

items.question: Trong câu "Binary search has its own topic later (off-by-one variants, first/last occurrence).", từ "occurrence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: occurrence /əˈkʌrəns/ (noun): an instance of appearing. "First occurrence" is the earliest place a value appears; the verb is "occur".

items.question: Trong câu "The full pattern has three steps: divide the problem into smaller subproblems, conquer each (usually recursively — a function calling itself on smaller input until a base case), then combine the results.", từ "conquer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: conquer /ˈkɒŋkə(r)/ (động từ): giải quyết. "Divide and conquer" = chia để trị; nghĩa gốc "conquer" là chinh phục bằng vũ lực.
items.explanationEn: conquer /ˈkɒŋkə(r)/ (verb): to solve a smaller part. "Divide and conquer" solves pieces separately; originally "conquer" means to take by force.

items.question: Trong câu "The full pattern has three steps: divide the problem into smaller subproblems, conquer each (usually recursively — a function calling itself on smaller input until a base case), then combine the results.", từ "recursively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The full pattern has three steps: divide the problem into smaller subproblems, conquer each (usually recursively — a function calling itself on smaller input until a base case), then combine the results.", what does "recursively" (adverb) mean?

items.explanationEn: recursively /rɪˈkɜːsɪvli/ (adverb): by calling itself again. "Solve recursively" means a function calls itself; the adjective is "recursive".

items.question: Trong câu "The full pattern has three steps: divide the problem into smaller subproblems, conquer each (usually recursively — a function calling itself on smaller input until a base case), then combine the results.", từ "combine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (động từ): kết hợp, gộp. "Combine the results" = gộp kết quả của các bài toán con; danh từ "combination".
items.explanationEn: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (verb): to join into one. "Combine the results" joins the subproblem answers; the noun is "combination".

items.question: Trong câu "A loop multiplies exp times — O(n).", từ "multiply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A loop multiplies exp times — O(n).", what does "multiply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: multiply /ˈmʌltɪplaɪ/ (động từ): nhân (phép toán). "Multiply exp times" = nhân exp lần; nghĩa khác là tăng lên nhanh chóng về số lượng.
items.explanationEn: multiply /ˈmʌltɪplaɪ/ (verb): to do multiplication. "Multiply exp times" means doing the multiplication that often; it can also mean to grow in number.

items.question: Trong câu "Compute half once: calling power twice per level makes T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(1), which is O(n) again.", từ "level" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: level /ˈlevl/ (noun): one layer of a recursion. "Per level" means for each layer of the recursion tree; there are log n levels.

items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (verb): to join into one. "Merge two sorted arrays" joins them in order; Git also uses "merge a branch".

items.question: Trong câu "Read the problem for signals:", từ "signal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡnəl/ (noun): a sign that suggests something. "Read the problem for signals" means looking for clues that suggest a pattern.

items.explanationEn: independent /ˌɪndɪˈpendənt/ (adjective): not relying on each other. "Independent halves" can be solved separately without using each other's results.

items.question: Trong câu "Say this trade-off out loud in an interview — "what if memory is tight?" is a common follow-up.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two things. A "time vs space trade-off" gives up one to gain the other.

items.question: Trong câu "Say this trade-off out loud in an interview — "what if memory is tight?" is a common follow-up.", từ "out loud" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (phrase): so others can hear. "Say it out loud" means speaking so others hear; interviewers want to hear your thinking.

items.question: Trong câu "Say this trade-off out loud in an interview — "what if memory is tight?" is a common follow-up.", từ "tight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: tight /taɪt/ (adjective): limited, with little spare. "Memory is tight" means little is available, like "a tight budget".

items.explanationEn: follow-up /ˈfɒləʊ ʌp/ (noun): a later related question. "A follow-up" is a question that builds on the last; the verb is "follow up" without a hyphen.

items.question: Trong câu "Sorting in place mutates the input", từ "in place" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: in place /ɪn pleɪs/ (phrase): within the original data. "Sort in place" works on the original array without a copy; "in place of" means instead of.

items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (verb): to get rid of. "Discard half the input" means dropping it, like "throw away".

items.question: Trong câu "Sort + two pointers is O(n log n), and sort() without (a, b) => a - b compares as strings.", từ "compare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: compare /kəmˈpeə(r)/ (verb): to check how things differ. "Compare as strings" treats values as text, so "10" comes before "9".

items.question: Trong câu "Shrink-while-valid assumes non-negative values.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): giả định. "Assume non-negative values" = giả định các giá trị không âm; danh từ "assumption".
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take as true. "Assume non-negative values" means expecting them to be true; the noun is "assumption".

items.question: Trong câu "indexOf/splice inside a loop restore O(n²); countUniqueValues rewrites its input.", từ "rewrite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "indexOf/splice inside a loop restore O(n²); countUniqueValues rewrites its input.", what does "rewrite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rewrite /ˌriːˈraɪt/ (động từ): ghi đè lên. "Rewrites its input" = ghi đè lên dữ liệu đầu vào; cũng dùng cho "rewrite the code" (viết lại mã).
items.explanationEn: rewrite /ˌriːˈraɪt/ (verb): to write over existing data. "Rewrites its input" means overwriting the original values; "rewrite the code" means redoing it.

items.question: Trong câu "State the naive complexity first, then name the pattern that removes the repeated work.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State the naive complexity first, then name the pattern that removes the repeated work.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ. "State the complexity" = nêu rõ độ phức tạp; danh từ "state" lại là trạng thái.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. "State the complexity" means say it clearly; the noun "state" means a condition.

items.question: Trong câu "Frequency counter: O(n) time for O(n) space (O(1) for a fixed alphabet); prefer Map for arbitrary keys.", từ "prefer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Frequency counter: O(n) time for O(n) space (O(1) for a fixed alphabet); prefer Map for arbitrary keys.", what does "prefer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prefer /prɪˈfɜː(r)/ (động từ): ưu tiên chọn. "Prefer Map for arbitrary keys" = nên chọn Map khi khóa bất kỳ; cấu trúc "prefer A to B".
items.explanationEn: prefer /prɪˈfɜː(r)/ (verb): to choose over another. "Prefer Map for arbitrary keys" means choose it first; the pattern is "prefer A to B".

items.question: Trong câu "Multiple pointers need ordered input; justify each move ("this element cannot be in any answer").", từ "justify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multiple pointers need ordered input; justify each move ("this element cannot be in any answer").", what does "justify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to show a good reason for
items.explanation: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (động từ): giải thích lý do. "Justify each move" = giải thích vì sao bước đó đúng; trong soạn thảo "justify" là căn đều hai lề.
items.explanationEn: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (verb): to show a good reason for. "Justify each move" means explain why it is correct; in text editing it means aligning both margins.

items.question: Trong câu "Divide and conquer: halving → O(log n); two halves + linear combine → O(n log n).", từ "halve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Divide and conquer: halving → O(log n); two halves + linear combine → O(n log n).", what does "halve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cut into two equal parts
items.explanation: halve /hɑːv/ (động từ): chia đôi. "Halving" = chia đôi mỗi bước, dẫn tới O(log n); đừng nhầm với "having".
items.explanationEn: halve /hɑːv/ (verb): to cut into two equal parts. "Halving" the input each step leads to O(log n); do not confuse it with "having".

items.question: Trong câu "Patterns are reusable shapes that cut brute-force complexity.", từ "brute-force" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Patterns are reusable shapes that cut brute-force complexity.", what does "brute-force" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: brute-force /ˌbruːt ˈfɔːs/ (tính từ): vét cạn. "Brute-force solution" = lời giải vét cạn, thử mọi khả năng; thường chậm nhưng dễ viết.
items.explanationEn: brute-force /ˌbruːt ˈfɔːs/ (adjective): trying every possibility. A "brute-force solution" tries every possibility; it is usually slow but easy to write.
